# Turkey MCP

> 41 MCP servers (246 tools) for Turkish web services, read-only by default — shopping, cars, real estate, travel, finance, news, jobs, food and more. Every server runs locally with uvx, no API key, no account.

> Start here — all-mcp is the main reference: one server containing all 60 MCP servers (Turkey 32, Germany 27, Bonbama 1), 324 tools behind a single config entry. Install only all-mcp (`claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user all-mcp -- uvx all-mcp`) and it routes each question to the right server itself. Page: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/turkey-mcp/#/en/tool/all-mcp — repo: https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/all-mcp

- [tcmb-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/tcmb-mcp) ([.md](https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/turkey-mcp/#/en/md/tcmb-mcp)): Live USD/TRY, EUR/TRY and 20 more FX rates from tcmb.gov.tr (official XML, no key). (4 tools)
- [arabam-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/arabam-mcp) ([.md](https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/turkey-mcp/#/en/md/arabam-mcp)): Search ~176k used-car listings on arabam.com: full 19-field specs, brand/model browser, market price stats (TRY). (5 tools)
- [emlakjet-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/emlakjet-mcp) ([.md](https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/turkey-mcp/#/en/md/emlakjet-mcp)): Search emlakjet.com sale/rent listings by city and district: full details with 14 spec fields, district browser, market price stats incl. median price per m² (TRY). (4 tools)

Optional local-session account actions: view/add/remove cart items and manage favorites (needs your own browser session cookie). (12 tools)

## Install

- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user <name> -- uvx <package>`
- Any MCP client: add `{"command": "uvx", "args": ["<package>"]}` under `mcpServers` in the client's config.
- All servers at once: clone https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/turkey-mcp and open it in Claude Code — `.mcp.json` registers every server.
- Profile builder (pick servers, get one ready config): https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/turkey-mcp/#/en/builder
